sample-turn1.note: Nothing playable: 5-cost minion in hand, 1 mana, board minion just played.

lethal-plain.note: Either attack order kills. END_TURN is wrong with lethal on board.

taunt-wall.note: Develop board; the 3-attack minion cannot clear the 8-HP taunt. Ending the turn with a playable minion is wrong.

overdraw-10.note: Play a minion first to make room; drawing with a full hand burns the drawn card.

empty-board-buff.note: A board buff with no board is wasted. Play the minion first.
